title: The Companion of the Practiced Illusionist
summary: A companion for illusionists past the courses that adds the settled counterfeit shot and a presence that fades from every sense.

title: A Treatise on the Wide Mirage
summary: A treatise on stretching one mirage over a whole company and on collapsing it into a blow that rattles all who stand within.

title: The Seeming Beyond the Eye
summary: A manual of casting the seeming through the qi field itself so that it reaches every sense of those who stand within.

title: The Twin-Court Illusionists' Canon
summary: A canon of the Azure Sky schools in which every illusion is cast as a pair and the foe must answer both halves at once.

title: The Hawk's Mirror Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the hawk's eye and the false sky it casts so that a foe watches a feather that is not there.

title: The Basin and River Phantasm
summary: A manual of the apex schools in which phantasms gather in the qi like water in a basin and run out as a flood of false shapes.

title: The Wind-Sworn Veil Reckoning
summary: A Gale reckoning of veils sworn to the wind that blow across a foe's senses and carry his sense of direction away.

title: The Plateau Mirage Canon
summary: A Gale canon of broad level mirages in which nothing seems to rise or fall and the foe cannot judge his footing.

title: Oath of the Bearing Seeming
summary: A manual of the Oath-Voices on a seeming sworn to hold a bearing until the foe's own sense of north is broken.
